name: LaserPecker LP3
tagline: Infrared portable LaserPecker for metal and plastic marking
tldr: LaserPecker LP3 focuses on infrared marking for metal and engineered plastics in a portable form factor. Different from LP4/LP5: prioritize if your work is metal tags and plastic, not large wood cutting.
mainObjective: Portable IR marking for metal and plastic personalization

priceRange.note: No longer sold new (Oct 2026); last known price

pros: Pulsed 1064 nm infrared: marks bare metal and plastics that blue diodes cannot touch
Open-frame: plan laser glasses, exhaust, and workspace rules from day one
Software on the profile: trial your workflow on scrap before production
cons: Clear cast acrylic and thick production cutting still favor CO₂, not diode power alone
Confirm optical wattage on the listing before you buy
beginnerNotes: This profile covers LaserPecker LP3. Read the TL;DR and benchmarks before buying, then compare nearby models on the Compare page.
proTips: Run scrap tests first. Use this profile’s reference times for quotes, not marketing claims.
primaryUse: Portable infrared marking for metal and plastic items.

editorialDepth.advantages: LaserPecker LP3 (1W pulsed 1064 nm IR) is a portable marker for metal tags, tools and plastics: fine marks without a fiber bench.
editorialDepth.limitations: Marking only: it does not cut wood or acrylic, and the field is small (115 × 80 mm oval). Not a production fiber laser.
